comparison.objective: Hold a notice at a line and fasten it to cork with a pushpin; candidate adjusts a robot gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually stabilize a sliding sheet while orienting and forcefully inserting a small pin versus driver/wrench seating and rotational counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Pin through the notice, notice aligned, both hands clear, and state retained for two seconds; earlier specs omitted final run scores but preserve the same rubric.
comparison.reason: Hold-and-press fastening of a sheet tests insertion force and sheet stabilization, not coupled threaded calibration.
